* The default implementation of accessibility delegate for the individual items of the * RecyclerView. *

* If you are overriding {@code RecyclerViewAccessibilityDelegate#getItemDelegate()} but still * want to keep some default behavior, you can create an instance of this class and delegate to * the parent as necessary.

methods.name: void saveOriginalDelegate(View itemView)
methods.comment:
* Saves a reference to the original delegate of the itemView so that it's behavior can be
         * combined with the ItemDelegate's behavior.

methods.name: AccessibilityDelegateCompat getAndRemoveOriginalDelegateForItem(View itemView)
methods.comment: * @return The delegate associated with itemView before the view was bound.
